title: Grounding Multilingual Multimodal LLMs With Cultural Knowledge
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures factual knowledge about cultural entities, where religion is one of the key properties. This includes identifying the religion associated with an entity (like a church), understanding religious attributes from images and text, and answering visual questions related to religious contexts.
findings: The model's performance improvements were analyzed across different cultural domains. While significant gains were observed in categories like Heritage, Media, and Food, domains such as Religion (2.08% gain) and Festivals (0.73% gain) showed only limited improvement. This suggests that abstract visual content or highly localized traditions, which are often characteristic of religious and festival-related content, remain challenging for the model to learn effectively.
